SMTO-UI-0019 — Reveal the saved value before you edit this connection

GUID: a8820ef5-2d2c-43f4-a86f-315fac6265ee
Slug: ui-parameter-reveal-required
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • This connection's settings are shown with secrets hidden, so they can't be edited or saved as they are. Your saved settings haven't been changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In Parameter Store, select this connection and open the Value tab. That's where the saved value and its reveal control are.
  2. Open Advanced: reveal and replace raw saved value, then select Reveal & edit value. SMTO only lets you edit after you show the real saved value, so hidden placeholders can't overwrite your secrets.
  3. Make your change in the revealed value and select Save. Don't type the hidden dots or stars back in as a password or key. Saving the hidden placeholder text would replace your real secret with useless characters.

What success looks like

  • The value is shown and editable, and saving finishes without this message.

If it still fails

  • If Reveal & edit value is greyed out or refused, you may not have permission to see this secret. Ask the person who manages this connection to make the change.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The HTTP profile editor rejected reading the profile because the loaded connection is a redacted display (projection_applied is true), which cannot be saved as the real value.

What this means

  • The HTTP profile editor attempts to read a connection value while its projection_applied flag still marks a redacted display. The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • The HTTP profile editor attempts to read a connection value while its projection_applied flag still marks a redacted display.

How to diagnose it

  • Check whether explicit Reveal has supplied the authorized raw value.

How to fix it

  • http_profile_editor.js read() throws while connection.projection_applied is true, and the editor controls stay disabled. Use the Parameter Store's explicit Reveal & edit value action to load the raw stored value before editing; never save redaction masks as credentials.
  • Use the parameter editor’s explicit Reveal action before editing the stored raw value. Do not save display masks as credentials.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Editing uses the actual intended value and never saves display masks.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass the unsupported-feature check or reinterpret an unsupported response as success.

Technical notes

  • The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
